proposedTargetAssertions: Explicit selected profile resources; preserve existing AM_MSG/AM_WORK/AM_SHARE and am_board/am_presence IDs/policies unless a separately reviewed migration authorizes changes.
Inspect all stream subjects/retention/storage/discard/max_age/replicas/dedupe and KV history/TTL/storage/replicas after cold provisioning and repeat. Retain durable probe values and revisions.
New warm reuse validates rather than automatically updates policies; mismatches fail clearly without deleting or changing legacy state.
One bounded total startup/connection deadline, including repeated attempts; wrong endpoint returns actionable unavailability before the approved bound.
Every provision success/failure closes owned connection in finally; partial resources are reported and compatible retry completes them without destructive reset.
Required missing-dependency/CA/endpoint/credential/revocation/interruption matrix remains explicitly assigned; this baseline covers only five requested cases.
Native macOS/Linux and WSL exact-candidate broker and deployment checks belong to implementation/gate, not this future assertion list.
